newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores sees Q1 shr loss $0.80-$0.90.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores sees Q1 shr loss $0.80-$0.90.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said on Tuesday it expected to report a first quarter earnings loss of between $0.80 and $0.90 per share, with results hurt by a disruption in merchandise flow.

The company, which reported a net fourth quarter loss of $2.62 per share versus a profit of $0.73, said the merchandise flow distuption was caused a reduction in the advance rate under an old credit pact. This hurt March sales too, it said.
Venture said it had recently closed and funded a new three-year $250 million revolving line of credit from BT Commercial Corp, an affiliate of Bankers Trust Co.

The agreement's higher credit limit and more favorable advance rates would provide the company with additional funding to aggressively implement its repositioning strategy and develop new opportunities and concepts, Venture said.

"We are confident that the improving comparable store sales trends we saw in December, January and February reflect growing customer acceptance of Venture's new family value format," said Robert Wildrick, Venture's chairman.

He said: "We had difficulty executing our strategy in March as a result of our funding situation, but the new credit facility should provide the capital we need to pursue our turnaround much more aggressively in the coming months."
